title: Instead Of The People Bringing Justice, They Get More Injustice! & Here Comes Some More… » Sons of Liberty Media
text:
Originally published July 24, 2025
“The violence of the wicked will [return to them and] drag them away [like fish caught in a net], Because they refuse to act with justice.” -Proverbs 21:7
When I was 14-years-old, I remember watching a martial arts movie called “Kill or Be Killed.” The title of the movie invoked the thought that either you are going to bring judgment upon the heads of the wicked or the wicked are going to continuously bring injustice upon the innocent (Psalm 94:16). Now that I am grown up and have read the Word of God in understanding the heart of the Lord (In part-Jeremiah 9:24) and the US Constitution, I have to say that I DO NOT UNDERSTAND the American people who stand down in the face of their oppressors, especially knowing that the Law is on the side of the people, under God, and that they have provisions in the Constitution to deal with the corrupt who assail them.
This is NOT what our forefathers taught us. In fact, it’s just the opposite (Isaiah 59:14)!
Let me explain, in part, what is happening in my home state of Minnesota. This is to show you what the people are inviting by allowing these installed criminals to continue.
Congressman Tom Emmer highlighted the treasonous crimes of CIA-installed pedophile and communist Governor Tim Walz.
Though treason is punishable by death, treasonous Walz was asked by Tom Emmer to merely give an apology (Proverbs 21:7). You heard me right.
Two weeks later, the people had still overlooked the treasonous crimes of Tim Walz in selling off their state to the enemy (Deuteronomy 28:68). So, what does he do? He made a bid to run for a third term to continue his criminal assault on Minnesota’s constituents.
I am here to tell you that the 5.9 million people of this state, including the police, despise this criminal and have so from the beginning of his administration. Yet, he remains a free criminal to do what he wills. Now, he is running for a third term? What is it that the people will not tolerate? Up to this point, there has been no impeachment or prosecution brought forth.
Tim Walz, who is from Nebraska, acts and sounds much like his counterpart, CIA-Installed and scoundrel Attorney General Keith Ellison, who is from Michigan and is caught up in yet another scandal: The 250-million-dollar theft from the Hungary Children Scandal. Of course, there were those who were thrown under the bus of justice, and rightly so, for the crimes that were orchestrated by those who have been overlooked and yet named.
Take a look at the list of names below. Most have been charged with wire fraud, conspiracy to commit federal programs bribery, federal programs bribery, conspiracy to commit money laundering, and money laundering.

The people listed were charged as part of the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme in Minnesota, which is a federal case that involves theft of $250 million from child nutrition programs during COVID.
All were indicted for submitting fraudulent meal claims, laundering funds, and bribery.
The scheme involved fake nonprofits claiming to serve millions of meals to children.
Up to this point, there have been no impeachment proceedings or prosecutions brought against Keith Ellison.
The people are told that he was voted in just like Tim Walz. They are not being voted into office. They are being installed.
This reminds me of Ilhan Omar, who is even hated by the Somalian population in Minnesota. Yet, the mainstream media highlights her as one of the most influential people in America despite her intent to overthrow this country. Yes, she is another CIA-Installed pawn.
It’s interesting how even her colonizing efforts in the 5th district have been rated the terrorist recruitment capital of America. Yet, there are still no arrests, and the people still cannot figure out what is happening in their own country.
Leave off justice, and you invite more injustice (Amos 6:3)! Up to this point, there has been no impeachment or prosecution brought against Omar.
What’s worse is that the mainstream media will sell to the people how she was voted into office. Nothing could be further from the truth!
Had enough yet?
One more step in showing you what the apathetic and tolerant people are bringing upon themselves and their children if justice is not wrought upon the obvious acts of the treasonous (Proverbs 7:1; Isaiah 26:9).
As treasonous Mayor of Minneapolis Jacob Frey dances like a fool for his handlers and sells out his people for 30 pieces of silver (Luke 22:48), in comes Muslim Omar Fateh the alleged winner (CIA-Installed) of the Minneapolis Mayoral candidacy. This pawn is busy on the senate floor highlighting the fact that “white People are the problem with this country.
Also, consider the fact that this “winner” of the candidacy for the mayor of Minneapolis has also been charged with Ballot fraud and taxpayer-funded $500,000 graft payoff to Somali TV.
The mainstream media would have you all believe that they were voted in by the people in the face of the facts. Omar, up to this point, has not been impeached as a senator nor prosecuted.
There is, and has been, massive voter fraud taking place throughout America for generations in this country.
In conclusion: I have met with the late Senator Bruce Anderson, Senator Eric Lucero, State Representative Walter Hudson, Ben Davis, Local law Enforcement, etc., and in response to the above crimes and demanding constitutional remedy and resolve by impeachment and prosecution (Article II, Section 4; Article I Section 3 Clause 7), they give no response.
The language of our said representatives is highlighting the crimes to their constituents with a half-smirk on their faces. All of this is occurring in the face of them swearing an oath to uphold the law against all enemies both foreign and domestic (Numbers 30:2; Deuteronomy 23:23).
People, you are being sold into the hands of your enemies (Judges 2:14)!
How could it be otherwise? Instead of the People bringing justice, they get more Injustice!
